rationale: The persona prizes mechanism-focused diagnostics and distrusts headline rates with confounded interpretations. Option 1 proposes a controlled ablation to distinguish a dataset artifact from genuine broadened suspicion before trusting the result—exactly the scope-disciplined, hypothesis-distinguishing approach they'd favor. Option 2 asserts a specific mechanism (widened suspicion catching incompetence) without evidence, which a rigor-focused researcher would treat as one unverified hypothesis among several rather than the interpretation.
